purpose: Remove sub-millimeter voxel stair-step artifacts while preserving anatomy
method: Taubin48 alternating iterations lambda0.35 nu0.36, then Manifold simplify0.05mm
visual_validation: Front, back, side and three-quarter neutral geometry renders inspected. Strong voxel woodgrain removed; muscle mass, gill grooves, hands/finger gaps and cloth folds retained. No material change to silhouette; slight remaining raw sculpt irregularity is real geometry. Eyes and teeth remain for separate detail engineering.
deviation_outliers: Largest prior source-distance outliers lie on hidden closure surfaces inside thigh/shorts and chest; exterior silhouette remains intact.
